summary: Iter 23 — focused verification of the send-for-approval absolute-URL + visible email-error fix. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_iter23_absolute_urls.py (4/4 pass) verifying POST /api/estimates/{id}/send-approval returns approve_url + reject_url that (a) start with 'https://', (b) contain the preview host, (c) end with correct ?action=approve|reject, (d) include /estimate-approval/{id}/{token}; email_sent=false and email_error is a non-empty string (SMTP 535 BadCredentials — EXPECTED); Origin header override does not break the absolute-URL invariant (env FRONTEND_URL takes precedence); the returned public link actually approves the estimate end-to-end via the no-auth /api/public/estimate-approval endpoint. Regression: /app/backend/tests/test_iter22_estimate_approval.py (14/14) + test_iter21_estimates.py (22/22) still pass — 36/36 pass in 18s. Frontend Playwright: Admin login -> created TEST_absurl_ui_<ts> estimate via /api/estimates -> /admin/estimates -> send-approval-{id} -> approval-client-email + submit -> approval-sent-result visible with (a) amber 'Email failed to send' warning, (b) new data-testid='email-error-detail' element showing 'Reason: (535, ...BadCredentials...)' (SMTP failure surfaced to UI as designed), (c) two <code> elements both starting with 'https://portal-construction.preview.emergentagent.com/estimate-approval/22/<token>?action=approve|reject' (ABSOLUTE), (d) copy-approve-link button click fires success toast 'Approve link copied' (clipboard readback denied by Playwright sandbox permission — not an app bug). Regression: opened the approve_url in a FRESH browser context (no cookies/login) -> estimate-approval-page rendered -> public-approve-button clicked -> approval-done panel visible, confirming the absolute link is end-to-end valid. Both bug fixes (absolute URL fallback + visible email error reason) are working as intended. SMTP 535 BadCredentials remains expected and is correctly surfaced to the user.
critical_code_review_comments: estimates.py send_for_approval — base URL fallback chain (FRONTEND_URL env -> Origin header -> x-forwarded-proto+host -> request.url.scheme+host) is solid and produces absolute URLs in all observed cases; consider logging which source was used so on-prem operators can debug quickly if the env var is missing.

send_approval_email — 'SMTP not configured' guard raises RuntimeError which propagates to email_error in response. Consider distinguishing config-missing vs auth-failed via structured error field (e.g., {code:'SMTP_AUTH_FAILED', detail:...}) so the frontend can render tailored copy — currently we show raw '(535, b'5.7.8...')' bytes-repr in the UI which is a bit ugly for end users.

SendForApprovalModal.jsx line 75 — String(result.email_error).slice(0,180) truncates but includes Python bytes-string repr like 'b\'5.7.8 ...\''. Consider a helper that strips b'...' wrapper for cleaner display; non-blocking.

The email_error message is truncated at 180 chars which is reasonable, but for the 535 case the truncation cuts off the Message-ID. Fine, since the actionable info ('BadCredentials' + support URL) fits within 180 chars.

Clipboard writeText failure in constrained browser contexts (no permission) currently only shows an 'Uncaught runtime error' overlay in dev mode; production build should be fine but consider wrapping navigator.clipboard.writeText in try/catch with a manual selection fallback for older/embedded browsers.
seed_data_creation: Created ~6 TEST_absurl_* estimates via API (backend tests) + TEST_absurl_ui_<ts> via frontend flow. All prefixed with TEST_ for cleanup.

If SMTP creds are ever fixed, email_sent will become true and email-error-detail will not render — flip that branch in the test. The public /estimate-approval/:id/:token page continues to work no-auth. Consider cleanup pass for the growing TEST_* estimate rows.
rca of the issue: Original bug: relative approval URLs when FRONTEND_URL env unset. Fix (verified): send_for_approval builds base = FRONTEND_URL || Origin header || (x-forwarded-proto+host) || request.url.scheme+host, then rstrip('/'). Ensures absolute URL in every deployment. Second fix (verified): SendForApprovalModal now renders data-testid='email-error-detail' with 'Reason: ...' text so users see why email failed. Third fix (verified): send_approval_email raises 'SMTP not configured' RuntimeError when env keys missing, which propagates to email_error in response body.
